metadata.title: NAVDevEnv
metadata.description: Wrapper for finsql.exe (Dynamics NAV Developer Enviroment)

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Get-CommonFinSQLArgument' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
